create_confusion_matrix_metric: create a confusion matrix metric using evaluate.load to evaluate classification accuracy
test_compute_confusion_matrix: test the compute method with predictions and references to generate a confusion matrix
review_Compute_with_labels: review the compute method to reorder or select a subset of labels in the confusion matrix
summarize_normalize_confusion_matrix: summarize how to normalize the confusion matrix over true, predicted conditions or the full population
build_multilabel_confusion_matrix: build a multilabel confusion matrix metric by setting config_name to multilabel for sequence inputs
